description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing displacement, direction, change of position or physical movement of a participant through lexical verbs such as go, come, walk and run.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar desplazamiento, dirección, cambio de posición o movimiento físico de un participante mediante verbos léxicos como ir, venir, caminar y correr.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar deslocamento, direção, mudança de posição ou movimento físico de um participante por meio de verbos lexicais como ir, vir, caminhar e correr.

metadata.notes: v0.2 defines Movement by lexical-semantic displacement, direction, change of position or physical movement. Action and Movement may overlap for verbs such as go, come, walk and run. Progressive aspect (BE + verb-ING) is a separate grammatical layer that may present Movement or Action as ongoing, but it does not define the Movement function itself. Boundaries remain intentionally permeable with Action, prepositions, timelines, sentence structure, questions and practical communication.
